bifrost: springboard/ui/src/chart.rs (LinearScale, axis_ticks, number_bins, sectors, point). Private chart drawing in springboard/src/shell/screentime/chart.rs and springboard/src/shell/battery.rs (Body::Graph in springboard/src/shell/list.rs)
summary: Swift Charts is a declarative SwiftUI API for marks, scales, axes and plots, with 2D, vectorized and 3D (macOS 26) charts. BifrOSt now has pure chart geometry in springboard/ui/src/chart.rs: a linear scale, automatic axis values, equal-width number bins and pie or donut sector spans. There is still no app-facing chart view or mark API in springboard/sdk/src, and the two shell charts keep their own drawing code.

features.bifrost: none. The sdk View trait (springboard/sdk/src/view/mod.rs:169) lets an app draw into a Surface by hand
features.note: no declarative chart container; apps would hand-draw every bar and label
bars are drawn only inside the Screen Time page; no app API
battery graph draws bins, not lines or areas (springboard/src/shell/battery.rs)

features.apple: PointMark, RectangleMark, RuleMark, PointPlot, RectanglePlot, RulePlot
features.note: no scatter, range or reference-line drawing in the SDK
angle spans and point placement only; no sector drawing, donut inner radius or SDK view

features.apple: VectorizedChartContent, AreaPlot, LinePlot, PointPlot, RectanglePlot, RulePlot, BarPlot, SectorPlot
features.note: no batched plot path; both shell charts take small fixed arrays

features.apple: ScaleType, ScaleDomain, AutomaticScaleDomain, ScaleRange, PositionScaleRange, PlotDimensionScaleRange
features.note: linear scales with an explicit domain and range; no automatic domain inference, no log or sqrt scale

features.apple: AxisMarks, AxisMark, AxisTick, AxisGridLine, AxisValueLabel, AxisValue, AxisContentBuilder
features.note: axis_ticks gives 1, 2 or 5 times a power of ten values; no grid line, tick style or label API

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/chart.rs (number_bins, Bin); springboard/src/shell/battery.rs:12 (24 hours in 15-minute bins)
features.note: equal-width numeric bins; no date bins and the battery graph does not use the shared function yet
no value callouts or labels attached to marks

features.feature: Chart proxy and plot area access
features.note: no way to map a pointer position to a data value; LinearScale::invert is the building block but no proxy exists
the scroll view (springboard/sdk/src/view/scroll.rs) has no chart snap behaviour
no 3D chart or surface renderer in springboard/render/src

features.apple: Chart accessibility and localization (Swift Charts landing page)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/ax.rs (generic accessibility model), springboard/ui/src/format.rs (number and date formatting)
features.note: no chart-level accessibility summary, audio graph or chart-specific labels; the shell bars have no accessible values

gaps: No app-facing chart API: no Chart container, no mark views and no plot views in springboard/sdk
The Screen Time bar chart and the battery graph are private shell drawers, not reusable by apps; neither uses springboard/ui/src/chart.rs yet
No line, area, point, rectangle, rule or sector drawing (sector geometry exists in springboard/ui/src/chart.rs)
No automatic scale domain and no log or sqrt scale; LinearScale needs an explicit domain
No date bins (DateBins); number_bins covers numeric data only
No axis grid lines, tick styling or axis label API; axis_ticks returns values only
No annotations and no chart proxy, so charts cannot respond to pointer position or selection
No 3D charts or surface plots (Chart3D is macOS 26.0 in Apple's docs)
No chart accessibility summaries or localized axis labels
docs/bifrost-ui.md has no dataviz or charts section, so the Apple parity record does not cover this framework
